title: Sentinel-2 多光譜觀測
summary: 將不同像元大小的波段配準至共同網格，保留反射率平均與品質遮罩。
summaryEn: Register bands of different pixel sizes to a shared grid while preserving reflectance averages and quality masks.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：四細像元面積和等於粗像元，不靠陣列尺寸猜配準。
steps.instructionEn:
Valid-only mean is 0.2 with 75% coverage, not a full-cell mean.
Return to the investigation: Draw four fine pixels and one coarse pixel, marking origin, boundaries and centres.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。有效平均為 0.2，覆蓋只有 75%；不能稱完整粗像元平均。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Valid-only mean is 0.2 with 75% coverage, not a full-cell mean.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 四細像元面積和等於粗像元，不靠陣列尺寸猜配準。
steps.checkEn: Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Sentinel-2 多光譜成像器以不同波段與空間取樣觀察陸地。
knowledge.textEn: Sentinel-2 observes land with multiple spectral bands and spatial sampling scales.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 將不同像元大小的波段配準至共同網格，保留反射率平均與品質遮罩。
knowledge.textEn: Register bands of different pixel sizes to a shared grid while preserving reflectance averages and quality masks.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 同面積像元聚合使用算術平均；重採樣增加像元數不會增加原始空間資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Equal-area aggregation uses an arithmetic mean; resampling to more pixels does not add native spatial information.

quiz.question: 「波段網格契約」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Band-grid contract: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: ρ20=(0.1+0.2+0.3+0.4)/4=0.25。反射率無量綱，總面積仍為 400 m²；不適用不等面積權重。
交付網格定義、聚合權重、覆蓋圖與原生解析度說明。
雲遮罩以雙線性插值後出現小數類別是處理錯誤；分類遮罩與連續反射率必須使用不同規則。
optionsEn: ρ20=(0.1+0.2+0.3+0.4)/4=0.25. Reflectance is dimensionless and area remains 400 m²; unequal areas require weights.
Deliver grid definition, aggregation weights, coverage map and native-resolution statement.
Fractional cloud classes after bilinear interpolation indicate a processing error; masks and continuous reflectance need different rules.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。雲遮罩以雙線性插值後出現小數類別是處理錯誤；分類遮罩與連續反射率必須使用不同規則。 與本階段判準一起判讀：四細像元面積和等於粗像元，不靠陣列尺寸猜配準。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Fractional cloud classes after bilinear interpolation indicate a processing error; masks and continuous reflectance need different rules. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.

steps.title: 波段網格契約 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Band-grid contract · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「波段網格契約」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Band-grid contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
雲遮罩以雙線性插值後出現小數類別是處理錯誤；分類遮罩與連續反射率必須使用不同規則。
對照「波段網格契約」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。分析解析度以最粗的必要輸入為限；遮罩未知值不能自動當成晴空。
本階段必須重驗：四細像元面積和等於粗像元，不靠陣列尺寸猜配準。
steps.instructionEn:
Fractional cloud classes after bilinear interpolation indicate a processing error; masks and continuous reflectance need different rules.
Against the nominal Band-grid contract result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Analysis resolution is limited by the coarsest required input; unknown mask values cannot become clear sky.
Reverify this criterion: Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。雲遮罩以雙線性插值後出現小數類別是處理錯誤；分類遮罩與連續反射率必須使用不同規則。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Fractional cloud classes after bilinear interpolation indicate a processing error; masks and continuous reflectance need different rules.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 四細像元面積和等於粗像元，不靠陣列尺寸猜配準。
steps.checkEn: Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.

quiz.questionEn: Band-grid contract: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 同面積像元聚合使用算術平均；重採樣增加像元數不會增加原始空間資訊。
分析解析度以最粗的必要輸入為限；遮罩未知值不能自動當成晴空。

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Analysis resolution is limited by the coarsest required input; unknown mask values cannot become clear sky. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.

steps.title: 波段網格契約 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Band-grid contract · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「波段網格契約」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Band-grid contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付網格定義、聚合權重、覆蓋圖與原生解析度說明。
在交接件中加入「波段網格契約」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：四細像元面積和等於粗像元，不靠陣列尺寸猜配準。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：將不同像元大小的波段配準至共同網格，保留反射率平均與品質遮罩。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver grid definition, aggregation weights, coverage map and native-resolution statement.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Band-grid contract: Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Register bands of different pixel sizes to a shared grid while preserving reflectance averages and quality masks. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。四細像元面積和等於粗像元，不靠陣列尺寸猜配準。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 四細像元面積和等於粗像元，不靠陣列尺寸猜配準。
steps.checkEn: Fine areas sum to the coarse area; array size alone does not establish registration.
